convert_squad_to_jsonl: convert a SQuAD dataset JSON file to a flat JSONL format with question and answer pairs
extract_question_answer_pairs: extract question and answer text pairs from a SQuAD dataset and write them to a JSONL file
flatten_squad_dataset: flatten a nested SQuAD dataset into individual question-answer JSON lines for downstream processing
run_squad_conversion: run the SQuAD conversion script with an input JSON file path and an output file path
review_squad_conversion_script: review the SQuAD dataset conversion script that transforms nested JSON into flat JSONL format
